mergewith.subtemplate:
<plugin id="constantPopIOModel.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.DummyModel"/>
<parameter name="alpha" id="popShape.$(n)" value="3.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <parameter name="mean" id="popMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/>
<distribution id="popShapePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@popShape.$(n)"> <lower id="popShapePriorLower.$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="popShapePriorUpper.$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="popMeanPrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@popMean.$(n)"> <M id="popMeanPriorMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <S id="popMeanPriorStdev.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="popShapeScale.$(n)" parameter="@popShape.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="popMeanScale.$(n)" parameter="@popMean.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>

<plugin id="constPopModel.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.ConstantPopulations" speciesTree="@Tree.t:Species"> <parameter dimension="10" name="populationSizes" id="constPopSizes.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </plugin>
<distribution id="constPopSizesPrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@constPopSizes.$(n)"> <distr id="Gamma.0.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.GammaMean"> <parameter name="alpha" id="constPopShape.$(n)" value="2.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <parameter name="mean" id="constPopMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distr> </distribution>
<distribution id="constPopShapePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@constPopShape.$(n)"> <lower id="constPopShapePriorLower.$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="constPopShapePriorUpper.$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="constPopMeanPrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@constPopMean.$(n)"> <M id="constPopMeanPriorMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <S id="constPopMeanPriorStdev.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="constPopSizesSwap.$(n)" parameter="@constPopSizes.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.RealCycle" k="2" optimise="false" weight="3.0"/> <operator id="constPopSizesScale.$(n)" parameter="@constPopSizes.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="constPopShapeScale.$(n)" parameter="@constPopShape.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="constPopMeanScale.$(n)" parameter="@constPopMean.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>

<plugin id="lwcrPopModel.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.LinearWithConstantRoot" speciesTree="@Tree.t:Species"> <parameter dimension="10" name="tipPopulationSizes" id="tipPopSizes.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <parameter dimension="10" name="topPopulationSizes" id="topPopSizes.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </plugin>
<distribution id="tipPopSizesPrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@tipPopSizes.$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma"> <parameter name="alpha" id="tipPopShape.$(n)" value="4.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <parameter name="theta" id="lwcrPopScale.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distr> </distribution>
<distribution id="topPopSizesPrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID" param="@topPopSizes.$(n)"> <distr spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma" theta="@lwcrPopScale.$(n)"> <parameter name="alpha" id="topPopShape.$(n)" value="2.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distr> </distribution>
<distribution id="tipPopShapePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@tipPopShape.$(n)"> <lower id="tipPopShapePriorLower.$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="tipPopShapePriorUpper.$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="topPopShapePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@topPopShape.$(n)"> <lower id="topPopShapePriorLower.$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="topPopShapePriorUpper.$(n)" value="10000.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="lwcrPopScalePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@lwcrPopScale.$(n)"> <M id="lwcrPopScalePriorMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <S id="lwcrPopScalePriorStdev.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="tipPopSizesSwap.$(n)" parameter="@tipPopSizes.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.RealCycle" k="2" optimise="false" weight="3.0"/> <operator id="topPopSizesSwap.$(n)" parameter="@topPopSizes.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.RealCycle" k="2" optimise="false" weight="3.0"/> <operator id="tipPopSizesScale.$(n)" parameter="@tipPopSizes.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="topPopSizesScale.$(n)" parameter="@topPopSizes.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="tipPopShapeScale.$(n)" parameter="@tipPopShape.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="topPopShapeScale.$(n)" parameter="@topPopShape.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="lwcrPopScaleScale.$(n)" parameter="@lwcrPopScale.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>

<plugin id="uniformPopModel.$(n)" spec="starbeast2.UniformPopulations" speciesTree="@Tree.t:Species"> <parameter name="universalSize" id="universalPopSize.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </plugin>
<distribution id="universalPopSizePrior.$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@universalPopSize.$(n)"> <M id="universalPopSizePriorMean.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <S id="universalPopSizePriorStdev.$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<operator id="universalPopSizeScale.$(n)" parameter="@universalPopSize.$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>
